_comment: Chain-agnostic protocol recipients. The same three addresses are used on EVERY chain, because an account's key works on every EVM chain — no per-chain forwarding contract is needed. EscrowV2 credits these addresses via its pull-pattern claimable balances and they call withdrawClaimable(token) on the chain holding the token. The three address fields in EscrowV2 (ODDAO, STAKING_POOL, PROTOCOL_TREASURY) are immutable, so this file is the single source of truth for every escrow deployment on every chain.
_doNotEdit: Addresses only. Private keys live in ~/.avalanche-cli/key/ and are never stored here.

_roles.oddaoTreasury: ODDao. Receives the 70% transaction slice, the 10% remainder of the transaction and listing splits, the 10% referral remainder, every zero-address attribution slot, and 100% of a judge-panel arbitration fee.
_roles.protocolTreasury: OB Protocol Treasury. Replaces the deployer account as the destination for protocol money (founder directive 2026-10-20).
_roles.stakingReserve: Staking share (20% of the transaction slice = 0.05% of each sale in kind). Accumulates per chain until a per-chain staking system exists to fund.
